lines.t:
The basic frame of a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>, combining the
functions of nerves and skeleton. Fitting it with a
<c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> completes the {{medabot}}.

There are two <c:ffff00>genders<c>, male {{type}} and female {{type}},
and only {{part|pl}} of the same {{gender}} can be fitted.
